name: Rudolf Steiner School of Montréal

geo.address: 4855, avenue de Kensington, Montréal, QC H3X 3S6
geo.coord_source: Ministère de l'Éducation du Québec open-data layer 'Installation d'enseignement privé' (COORD_X/Y_LL84), updated 2026-10-26

description: French-language private Waldorf school (elementary and first cycle of secondary, i.e. Secondary 1–2) with a private kindergarten/garderie, housed in the heritage former Fraser-Hickson library. The school states it is a private francophone school subsidised by the Ministère de l'Éducation.

attributes.philosophy: Waldorf pedagogy 'respecting the standards of the ministère de l'Éducation'; class teacher who stays with the class over several years.

legal_status.label: Private educational institution holding a permit under the Act respecting private education (Québec); subsidised (school statement)
legal_status.province_category: Subsidised (agréé aux fins de subventions) — per school website, not confirmed in the ministry layer

attributes.curriculum: Québec Education Program delivered through Waldorf pedagogy.
attributes.qualifications_offered: None (school ends at Secondary 2; the Québec DES is completed elsewhere).

tuition.notes: Gross tuition not published. The 2025-2026 financial-aid simulation shows an annual family outlay after aid and returns of $1,638 (family income $30,000), $6,054 ($50,000), $7,646 ($75,000) and $8,921 ($100,000+).

attributes.admission: Open houses each October and February; contact admissions@ersm.org.

campuses.name: Kensington
campuses.address: 4855, avenue de Kensington, Montréal, QC H3X 3S6

advantages: Subsidised, so fees are far below unsubsidised private schools
Heritage building in a central residential district
limitations: French-language instruction only; as a subsidised school it is bound by the Charter of the French Language, so a newcomer child without an eligibility certificate is taught in French
attributes.qualifying_reason: Model (Waldorf) and private status confirmed (ministry private-installation layer; school site). Gross tuition is not published — only a 2025-26 aid simulation — so SPEC §7 'tuition with its school year' is not met. Strong candidate for French-speaking or French-learning families.
